learning_outcomes.text: Learns basic knowledge about the fundamentals and analysis of Modern Power Systems.
Understands basic knowledge about Economic Load Dispatch and models it with computer algorithms.
Performs the analysis of Environmental and Dynamic Economic Load Dispatch problems.
Learns basic knowledge about Power Flow and Optimal Power Flow.
Solves Power Flow problems in a computer environment using mathematical methods.
Solves complex power system problems using metaheuristic methods in a software-based manner.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Computer-Aided Power Systems Analysis and Economic Load Dispatch Problem
Modeling of Economic Load Dispatch Problem in Computer Environment
Solution of Economic Load Dispatch Problem with Lagrange Method and Software Application
Environmental and Dynamic Economic Load Dispatch Problems
Computer-Aided Analysis of Environmental and Dynamic Economic Load Dispatch Problems
Economic Load Dispatch Problem with Renewable Energy Sources
Introduction to Power Flow Analysis and Basic Matrix Models
Introduction to Power Flow Analysis and Basic Matrix Models
Power Flow Analysis with Newton-Raphson Method and Computer Application
Power Flow Analysis with Gauss-Seidel Method and Computer Application
Introduction to Optimal Power Flow Problem
Optimal Power Flow Analysis with Renewable Energy Sources
Computer Solution of Economic Load Dispatch Problems with Renewable Energy Sources using Metaheuristic Search Algorithms
Solution of Optimal Power Flow Problems with Renewable Energy Sources using Metaheuristic Search Algorithms and Project Presentations
